chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 350: Li Huowang Returns to a Dog Fight and a Dark Discovery
chapter_meta_description: Gouwa strikes gold with Bai family secrets! Li Huowang returns to the inn only to deal with absurd canine drama. A slower chapter with big implications.
og_title: The Spoils of War: Greed, Grief, and a Dog Bite
og_description: Li Huowang is back, but the side characters are making their own moves. Discover what Gouwa found in the Bai family cellar.
twitter_title: Ch. 350: The side characters are scheming while Li Huowang deals with a very territorial dog.
twitter_description: Gouwa has found some dangerous books. Can Chun Xiaoman keep the group from going down a dark path?

surfaces: Hymns of Enlightenment from Bitter Effort
lore_anchors.definition: A forbidden text of the Luo Sect (罗教), a Ming Dynasty folk Buddhist sect that heavily influenced the White Lotus tradition. Its presence confirms the Bai family's deep heretical lineage.
A high-ranking eunuch official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office, wielding both bureaucratic and supernatural authority.
A handler in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; his compound surname marks him as being from a non-Han clan.
